$$
\int 4 \cdot 3^{x} \sqrt{3^{x} + 4}\,\mathrm{d}x
$$

Work where $3^{x} + 4>0$.

{{answer}} $+C$"] [:db/add "d2c1b3c9-c97f-5f96-b1e6-8c1a8a5d5166" :question/worked-solution "Let $u=3^{x} + 4$. Then $\mathrm{d}u=(3^{x} \ln{\left(3 \right)})\,\mathrm{d}x$.

Work where $3^{x} + 4>0$.

Including the differential factor gives

$$
\begin{aligned}&\int 4 \cdot 3^{x} \sqrt{3^{x} + 4}\,\mathrm{d}x\\&=\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right).\end{aligned}
$$

Use the integration rule:

$$
\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u=\frac{2 u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}+C.
$$

$$
\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\int \sqrt{u}\,\mathrm{d}u\right)=\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\frac{2 u^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)+C.
$$

Substitute back:

$$
\frac{4}{\ln{\left(3 \right)}}\left(\frac{2 \left(3^{x} + 4\right)^{\frac{3}{2}}}{3}\right)+C.
$$"] [:db/add "d2c1b3c9-c97f-5f96-b1e6-8c1a8a5d5166" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "d2c1b3c9-c97f-5f96-b1e6-8c1a8a5d5166" :question/answer-fields "57ddf01a-f4b7-53a2-beda-c85868fc3d10"] [:db/ensure "d2c1b3c9-c97f-5f96-b1e6-8c1a8a5d5166" :question/validate] [:db/add 17592186184351 :knowledge-point/questions "d2c1b3c9-c97f-5f96-b1e6-8c1a8a5d5166"] [:db/add "bc6c2ae8-6b02-559c-85bd-c3849fdd5eba" :answer/id #uuid "bc6c2ae8-6b02-559c-85bd-c3849fdd5eba"] [:db/add "bc6c2ae8-6b02-559c-85bd-c3849fdd5eba" :answer/type :answer.type/math] [:db/add "bc6c2ae8-6b02-559c-85bd-c3849fdd5eba" :answer/value "\frac{2}{\ln{\left(5 \right)}}\left(\ln\left|5^{x} + 2\right|\right)"] [:db/ensure "bc6c2ae8-6b02-559c-85bd-c3849fdd5eba" :answer/validate] [:db/add "15c1212f-262c-5037-99c0-082ac53c1a70" :answer-field/id #uuid "15c1212f-262c-5037-99c0-082ac53c1a70"] [:db/add "15c1212f-262c-5037-99c0-082ac53c1a70" :answer-field/key "answer"] [:db/add "15c1212f-262c-5037-99c0-082ac53c1a70" :answer-field/type :answer-field.type/blank] [:db/add "15c1212f-262c-5037-99c0-082ac53c1a70" :answer-field/choices "bc6c2ae8-6b02-559c-85bd-c3849fdd5eba"] [:db/add "15c1212f-262c-5037-99c0-082ac53c1a70" :answer-field/correct "bc6c2ae8-6b02-559c-85bd-c3849fdd5eba"] [:db/ensure "15c1212f-262c-5037-99c0-082ac53c1a70" :answer-field/validate] [:db/add "c46741f4-bd53-5442-a723-dfe845118a09" :question/id #uuid "c46741f4-bd53-5442-a723-dfe845118a09"] [:db/add "c46741f4-bd53-5442-a723-dfe845118a09" :question/problem "Find an antiderivative.
